$Comment:
The Millwright's Hatchet, the sawmill's EARNED tool: it is the claim reward on Sawmill_Lumber_T9, the top rung of the sawmill_lumber achievement ladder, so anyone who mills long enough walks away with a hatchet whether or not the mill ever drops the Sawmiller's. It is the lesser of the pair on purpose. Every channel sits a notch under the Sawmiller's Hatchet and it carries no flair, so the chase find keeps its standing; what it adds instead is a small Crafting cut the trophy has none of, which suits a tool earned by turning logs into boards rather than by luck.

Cut and wear are identical to the Sawmiller's: a Woods gather power of 0.55, the highest any hatchet reaches, and MaxDurability 500. Quality is Epic and the head is Onyxium so the two are never confused in a hotbar. No Parent and no Recipe, so no vanilla crafting or salvage recipe can be inherited and the hatchet stays reward-only. Tags.Family Hatchet is authored explicitly (vanilla gathering tools carry no Family tag yet) so the station's tag gate recognizes it beside the functional Woods gather route.

The four stats apply only while the hatchet is HELD, and the MMO's equip stat bridge applies them: the native stat manager reads a Utility block off the separate utility accessory slot only, never off a held tool. Utility.Compatible stays true and Usable stays unauthored, which keeps the block a side-effect-free stat surface (the hatchet can never occupy the utility slot itself, so nothing applies these stats twice).

What the four stats feed. Stamina 5 is a flat addition to the worker's MAXIMUM stamina, the native stat every guard and sprint drains. MMO_BonusXp_WOODCUTTING 22 is plus 22 percent Woodcutting experience and MMO_BonusXp_CRAFTING 12 plus 12 percent Crafting experience, each multiplied into its own skill's awards, sawmill cycles included. MMO_Luck_WOODCUTTING 22 is plus 22 percentage points of Woodcutting luck, feeding the MMO's luck ladders and every scored roll this pack ships: SawmillLuckFinds' find-tier score, SawmillOutputLadders' bonus-plank ladder and SawmillMasterworkBonus' chance. Percent-family MMO stats author their PERCENT as the Amount, and every entry is Additive on purpose: these channels carry a base of zero, and additive folds before multiplicative, so a Multiplicative-only entry here would compute zero and be silently inert.

All four amounts are initial balance and tunable without an engine change; keep them under the Sawmiller's if you want the drop to stay the better hatchet.
